assertions.check: Contains a clear go/no-go recommendation with stated confidence level
Lists the 3 riskiest assumptions and how each was tested
Customer discovery plan specifies who to talk to (job title, company type) and sample questions
Kill criteria are defined with specific thresholds (not vague conditions)
Each kill criterion is evaluated against actual findings from research
Positioning statement differentiates from competitors found in the competitor matrix
References specific data from the competitor matrix and market sizing (not standalone)
Identifies at least one risk that could kill the startup post-launch

meta_assertion: Would a co-founder trust this report enough to commit 6 months of their life to this idea?
test_prompt: Write a validation report for a developer deployment automation tool, synthesizing competitor and market research.
